chunks: He said: Al-Sharif Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Jawani reported to me from al-Mudhaffar ibn Ja'far al-Alawi al-Umari, who reported from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Mas'ud, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Hatim, who reported from Suwaid ibn Sa'id, who reported from Muhammad ibn Abdul Rahim al-Yamani, from Ibn Mina', from his father, that Aisha said:

Once Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny) seeking permission to enter, but he did not permit him. So he sought permission once again, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny) said: "Enter, O Ali." When he entered, the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his progeny) stood up toward him, embraced him, kissed him between the eyes, and said: "May my father be ransom for the martyr; may my father be ransom for the lonely martyr."

key_terms.الشهيد: Martyr (shahid) -- one who dies in the cause of God; here a prophecy about Ali's assassination
key_terms.الوحيد: The lonely/solitary one -- indicating Ali would be abandoned and alone at the time of his martyrdom

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) foretell the martyrdom of Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS)?
ai.summary: Aisha narrates that Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) came to the Prophet (SAWW) seeking entry. After initially not being permitted, the Prophet invited him in, embraced him, kissed him between the eyes, and prophetically referred to him as 'the lonely martyr' -- a foretelling of Ali's martyrdom and the solitary manner in which he would face his fate. This narration from al-Amali al-Mufid emphasizes the Prophet's deep love for Ali and his foreknowledge of Ali's future martyrdom.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Al-Sharif Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Jawani reported to me from al-Mudhaffar ibn Ja’far al-Alawi al-Umri, who reported from Ja’far ibn Muhammad b Masood, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Hatim, who reported from Suwaid ibn Saeed, who reported from Muhammad ibn Abdul Rahim al-Yamani, from Ibn Meena, from his father who reported that Aisha said:

Once ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) came upon the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, seeking permission to enter, but he did not permit. So, he sought permission once again and the Prophet peace be upon him and his progeny, said: "Enter, O ‘Ali." When ‘Ali entered, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, stood up, embraced him and kissed him between the eyes and said: "May my father be ransom for the martyr; may my father be ransom for the lonely martyr."
